meta.name: himalayan_monastery_spur
meta.prompt: A Himalayan monastery town clinging to a cliff spur above a glacial river: a whitewashed dzong with a gold-roofed assembly hall, prayer-flag lines strung across the gorge, a rope bridge, yak byres on the terraces below, and a giant bronze bell in a tower that rings over the whole valley.

params.brief: A monumental whitewashed stone belfry tower banded in dark timber, housing a massive cast bronze temple bell hung beneath a flared golden hip roof, projecting chimes over the entire valley.
A long swaying Himalayan rope suspension bridge crossing high over the glacial gorge, with thick suspension cables, timber plank walkway, and heavy stone abutments wrapped in prayer flags.
Multiple sagging lines of colorful Tibetan prayer flags strung across the gorge between tall timber masts on opposite cliff edges, fluttering wildly over the abyss.
